test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

4, 21, 41, 66, 98, 141, 197, 270, ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80b4b7f711b1cec1aba423d876b2b36a5496373c111d69276aba8aaa39b1397f.png] 

 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19 form a series of consecutive prime numbers.

Hence, the missing number is __**362**__.
